Description: Reliable hourly market data in a star schema
As an analyst I want hourly prices in the warehouse so that I can compute capture rates. Acceptance: 8,784 rows for 2024; rerun adds no duplicates.
As an analyst I want to read ENTSO-E documents so that I can replace synthetic data. Acceptance: sample file gives 4 points; position 1 = start time.
As an investor I want the solar capture rate by month so that I can see seasonal value. Acceptance: matches SQL and Python within 0.001.
As an investor I want the price effect of extra solar so that I can stress future revenues. Acceptance: slope and R² reported.
Return and risk of solar and storage
As an investment committee member I want IRR, NPV and LCOE so that I can compare with the hurdle rate. Acceptance: unit tests for NPV/IRR.
As an investment committee member I want P10/P50/P90 and the probability below hurdle so that I see downside risk.
As an investor I want an upper bound for battery arbitrage so that I can judge whether storage is worth adding. Acceptance: O(n) equals brute force on 200 random days.
As an ESG analyst I want avoided CO2 with an hourly factor versus a yearly average so that I avoid overstating impact.
As a stakeholder I want a one-page report with KPIs and the capture-rate chart so that I can decide quickly.
